content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked extensive information about several upcoming Apple home products. These include a new HomePod mini, a security camera, a Siri remote for the next-generation Apple TV 4K, and the long-awaited HomePad device.

After digging deeper into the code, it also seems to provide significant clues about the specifications we can expect from the HomePad...

Filipe Espósito from Engadget found indications that although the HomePad will likely run a variant of tvOS, it may operate more like a giant Apple Watch.

The code also reveals a very practical privacy feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information within widgets when it detects that your iPhone is nearby.

We expect the HomePad to come in two versions, one with a speaker base similar to the HomePod, and another designed for wall mounting.

In addition to the other Apple home products I mentioned above, there are also some unknown devices referenced. I'm really hoping that includes a smart doorbell. Is there any potential Apple home product you're particularly looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
